propositions: The ticket-type map is duplicated in two locations under adapters/ (jira/outbound_fields.py:88 and jira_datacenter/backend.py:43), creating divergence risk similar to the prior fe15 status-map defect.
The existing boundary guard for one-literal enforcement covers STATUS and PRIORITY maps but not the TYPE map, leaving no guard against future copies.
The two existing TYPE map copies are content-identical (same four key-value pairs, differing only in key order), so unification is behaviour-preserving on both Cloud and DC deployments.
Consolidate the single TYPE map definition into adapters/jira_family/value_maps.py and have both create paths import it under the _LOCAL_TO_JIRA_TYPE alias, following the J2 precedent.
Extend the boundary guard to enforce exactly one TYPE map literal exists under adapters/, and mutation-test the guard by re-introducing a second literal to verify it fails as intended.
